editorialDirection.sequence: Товары → поступления → история остатков → магазины → начало работы → отчёты → выбор тарифа → показ
editorialDirection.design: Approved owner reference governs the complete series. No fake CTA buttons, footer URLs, old slash marks or translated BAZAAR.
editorialDirection.languagePolicy: One primary RU package per slot; KG alternatives after native editorial review and explicit slot selection. Do not automatically double-post.
editorialDirection.scheduleStatus: Draft only, never schedule until complete package approval and separate publication authorization. Shift all dates if start is missed; no catch-up bulk posts.

brandRules.name: BAZAAR
brandRules.translation: Never translate or transliterate BAZAAR; preserve Latin spelling in Russian, Kyrgyz and English.
brandRules.posUsage: POS is only part of the Instagram username, not part of the display brand name.
brandRules.referencePolicy: Past Instagram posts demonstrate content sequence only. Do not copy their layout or reuse their decoration as mandatory brand assets.
excludedElements: two diagonal symbols from old post
brandRules.typography: Preserve letterforms, dense clean sans-serif character and sizes from owner-approved-stock-cover.png. Font family of raster source is unverified. Cormorant Garamond and Oswald trials rejected; no new typeface experiment in production series.
brandRules.rendering: Specialised design application only. Local code-based post generator is stopped.
brandRules.logo: Use the original public/brand/logo.png asset at the top instead of typeset BAZAAR. Never redraw or translate the logo.
brandRules.posterFooter: No bazaar.kg footer on artwork. Tracking links stay in profile, Story links and ad destinations.
brandRules.copy: Use concrete shop situations and plain language. No internal material IDs in public Direct keywords. Every slide must add information.
brandRules.composition: Preserve owner-approved hierarchy, scale, margins, blue/white photographic composition. Vary relevant photo subjects and product demonstrations within this direction; never shrink all text to make copy fit.
brandRules.artworkCta: No simulated clickable buttons in PNGs. Organic cover may omit CTA; last slide/caption gives one Direct or profile instruction. Stories reserve room for a real link sticker or reply. Paid ads use native CTA only after budget approval.
